intro: Lebanon is home to around 18 recognised religious communities, and many more Lebanese live abroad than at home.

chapters.title: Many faiths
text: Sunni and Shia Muslims, Maronite and other Christians, and Druze are the largest groups. No official census has been held since 1932 because of how sensitive the balance is.
Arabic is the official language, and French and English are widely spoken.

chapters.title: Lebanese abroad
text: Millions of people of Lebanese descent live in Brazil, the US, Australia, West Africa and elsewhere. Lebanon also hosts many Syrian and Palestinian refugees.

keyTerms.meaning: An official count of a population.
